result.title: A Perturbation-Driven Framework for Sensitivity Analysis of Dimensionality Reduction
result.comment: This manuscript is currently under review
result.summary: Low-dimensional representations produced by dimensionality reduction (DR) are commonly evaluated using distortion measures such as trustworthiness and continuity. In this paper, we study the sensitivity of DR methods to plausible input variations by quantifying changes in structural preservation and visually diagnosing how these changes manifest in the resulting representations. This perspective reflects the fact that real-world datasets are finite, noisy samples of an underlying distribution, and DR should not produce substantially different structures under small data changes. We introduce a model-agnostic, perturbation-driven sensitivity evaluation framework that treats perturbations as controlled probes of plausible data variation. Across multiple perturbation families and strength levels, we repeatedly perturb the input, apply a DR method, and evaluate the resulting low-dimensional representations using a set of distortion measures to derive sensitivity profiles for each DR method. We demonstrate the utility of our framework through case studies on DR method comparison, behavior analysis, and robustness improvement. We find that methods performing well according to conventional distortion measures (e.g., t-SNE) can still exhibit substantial sensitivity, leading to instability in visually salient structures such as trajectories and clusters, while certain methods (e.g., multidimensional scaling) may exhibit improved structural preservation under specific perturbations. These results highlight the importance of sensitivity analysis for comparing DR methods, diagnosing perturbation-sensitive visual patterns, and guiding the development of more robust DR methods toward trustworthy visual analytics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个模型无关、扰动驱动的敏感性评估框架：对输入施加多类多强度扰动后重复降维，用 trustworthiness、continuity 等失真度量刻画结构保持的变化，形成各方法的敏感性画像，并用于方法比较、行为诊断与稳健性改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扰动探针＋结构保持度量」的评价思路可能可供核查地借用来检验 LVR 内部视觉表示在输入微小变化下是否保持结构稳定，但论文本身面向可视化降维评价，未涉及推理状态生成或答案使用。
